prompt.objetivo: Run the archetype canon with the current SAD as the attached document. Do not rewrite the canon.

hacer.paso: Read sources/canon/archetype-prompt.xml and obey its analysis, its pre-generation report, its stop, and its structure.

The current SAD replaces the initial request to "attach the SAD". Do not ask for the document again when current/sad/SAD.md exists and is complete against the format. If it is missing decisions, a stack, or quality attributes, list the gaps and stop: that is a blocker of the canon itself.
Adapt the blueprint to the structure already written in the SAD and to the stack present in the repository. The canon's base structure is the starting point, not a reason to discard the project.
In validar mode, obey the canon's wait. In continuo mode, choosing that mode counts as confirmation only when the report has no blockers. Assumptions stay written in the promoted blueprint.
After confirmation, generate the archetype in the project tree and leave the approved structure in current/arquetipo/BLUEPRINT.md, so the code can be checked against it later.

prohibido.regla: Do not generate the full project before the confirmation the canon requires, except for the explicit condition of continuo mode.
Do not add dependencies outside the current SAD without marking them as a proposal.
